title: application-policy-v2
description: Caller-owned origin and verifier-policy selection for the cooperating application; this record is not a verifier trust decision.

origin.description: Locally approved HTTPS origin for evidence collection and later application access.

verifier_policy.description: Path to the caller-selected verifier policy, resolved by the application.

allow_untrusted_bootstrap.description: Permit credentialless evidence retrieval before the attested TLS peer is authenticated; admission still requires the separate peer check.
